name: Thunderkeg spawns its gameobject (#5726)
contract: Conjure Thunderkeg 807849 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR with EffectMiscValue 195002 (Spell.dbc). Spell::EffectTransmitted (SpellEffects.cpp) looks the id up with sObjectMgr->GetGameObjectTemplate and silently returns, logging an error, when the row is missing; no gameobject_template row for 195002 existed anywhere before this fix, so the cast animation played but nothing was ever placed. The new pending_db_world migration adds gameobject_template entry 195002 (type 22 GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SPELLCASTER, displayId 1013445, name 'Thunderkeg', sourced from hertigservices/ascension-data exiles-db-export-2026-09-13), so the cast must now leave exactly one owned gameobject of that entry near the caster.

steps.label: The Thunderkeg gameobject is placed near the caster
